purpose: Render an ordered navigation hierarchy with native links or actions and a current-page endpoint.
behaviorProvider: Native nav, ordered list, anchor and button elements.

requirements.statement: Render a nav landmark with default accessible name Breadcrumb and an ordered list; supplied nav attributes may override the default name.
Render the final item as a span with aria-current=page regardless of supplied href or onClick; it is not an interactive ancestor.
Render nonfinal items with href as native anchors, preserving browser link behavior and invoking an optional item callback on click.
Render nonfinal items without href but with onClick as type=button controls; items without either are plain text spans.
Hide each visual separator from the accessibility tree; the default separator is a shared chevron icon.
Supply the hierarchy in ancestor-to-current order, with the current page last. The component does not derive routes or validate whether an item is an ancestor.
Provide safe appropriate href values and implement application navigation. A click callback on an anchor is not itself a router adapter or an automatic preventDefault.
Provide meaningful item labels and appropriately hidden or named custom icons; give multiple breadcrumb landmarks distinct accessible names when needed.
Own pattern or component styling consumes navigation group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No route detection, URL validation, collapsing, overflow menu or asynchronous navigation handling.
No disabled item API; current items are plain text and other unavailable items must be modelled by the host.
The array order determines the current item; no active-route matching occurs.
